title: NHC's 2025 season verification: Google DeepMind ensemble mean outperformed official short-range Atlantic track forecasts in NHC's first operational use of AI models
summary: NHC's 2025 verification: Google DeepMind ensemble mean beat official Atlantic track forecasts at 12-72 h; first AI models in NHC operations.
account: The National Hurricane Center's Forecast Verification Report for the 2025 season, dated 30 March 2026, states that 2025 marked the first time NHC incorporated AI-based models into real-time operations. In the Atlantic track comparison, the Google DeepMind ensemble mean (GDMI) slightly outperformed the official forecast at lead times from 12 to 72 h, while official forecasts outperformed the consensus aids TVCA, HCCA and FSSE. In the eastern North Pacific, GDMI performed considerably better than every other individual model and beat the official forecast and all consensus aids at 48-120 h; for intensity it was the top individual model from 12 to 48 h. GDMI was not available early in the season, so the first storms are excluded from these comparisons.
purpose: Experimental AI tropical cyclone forecast model providing ensemble track and intensity guidance to NHC forecasters.
system: Google DeepMind AI hurricane forecast model, ensemble mean designated GDMI in NHC guidance
